item.title: Voyager One becomes the first spacecraft to reach one light-day from Earth
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with NASA's Nicky Fox about the legacy of Voyager 1 and its achievement of traveling one light-day from Earth.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with NASA's Nicky Fox about the legacy of Voyager 1 and its achievement of traveling one light-day from Earth.
item.dc:creator: Leila Fadel

item.title: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft reaches a distance of 1 light-day from Earth
item.description: Early Wednesday morning, Voyager 1 will make history by reaching exactly one light day away from Earth.
item.content:encoded: Early Wednesday morning, Voyager 1 will make history by reaching exactly one light day away from Earth.
item.dc:creator: Sanden Totten

item.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
item.description: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.
item.content:encoded:
The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

(Image credit: Eric Gay)
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: SpaceX deploys Starlink satellites in Starship test, but booster crashes into Gulf
item.description: SpaceX conducted a major test of its Starship rocket Friday night. It deployed several satellites for the Starlink constellation, but there was a problem with its booster.
item.content:encoded: SpaceX conducted a major test of its Starship rocket Friday night. It deployed several satellites for the Starlink constellation, but there was a problem with its booster.
item.dc:creator: Geoff Brumfiel

item.title: How flying around the moon affected astronaut Jeremy Hansen's perspective of humanity
item.description: Jeremy Hansen was one of four astronauts to fly around the moon on the Artemis II mission this year. His new book is Earthrise: Inside Artemis II, the Groundbreaking Human Mission Into Deep Space.
item.content:encoded: Jeremy Hansen was one of four astronauts to fly around the moon on the Artemis II mission this year. His new book is Earthrise: Inside Artemis II, the Groundbreaking Human Mission Into Deep Space.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Martin

item.title: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
item.description: As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Launch-ready, the Space Shuttle Endeavour goes back on display
item.description: The Space Shuttle Endeavour has been on display in California since 2012 — not long after NASA ended the program. Now, the California Science Center is showing off the shuttle in a new way.

item.title: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
item.description: As the spaceflight and AI company charges ahead with a more powerful rocket, it's retiring a workhorse for the space agency. What will NASA do?

item.description: NASA needs more recruits in order to return to the moon after being gone more than half a century.

item.title: White dwarf stars come in a surprising number of colors, study finds
item.description: Turns out these remnants of dying stars are not all white – a new study finds that they can come in a wide array of colors, from salmon pink to chartreuse.
